hero.title: Build and validation workflow
hero.description: Use these commands as the baseline validation flow when changing shared patterns or build tooling.

coreCommands.title: Core commands
items: `npm run build` → internal link check + SSR/prerender build
`npm run preview:nojs` → serve prerendered output for no-JS QA
`npm run preview:nojs:build` → rebuild then no-JS preview

dependencySecurity.title: Dependency security maintenance
items: Run `npm audit` to identify lockfile-level dependency vulnerabilities.
Apply low-risk remediations with `npm audit fix`.
Re-run `npm run build` after lockfile updates before merging.
Treat this as required maintenance across all template-based repos.

whenToUseNoJs.title: When to use no-JS preview
items: Form modal fallback changes (`FormEmbedModal`, helper links, `js-only` behavior)
Header/menu behavior that depends on `details/summary` or CSS-only fallbacks
